grammar.title: Bringing out with V + 出
grammar.explanation: 出 (chū) after a verb shows something comes out or is revealed through the action — "figure out, point out, take out". It's a very productive resultative complement, seen in words like 找出, 拿出, 提出, and 指出.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mǎshàng jiù rènchū le tā.
